items.text: Among admission decisions in the emergency department from March 2025 to February 2027, what are the sensitivity and specificity of the command centre flag at the deployed threshold for boarding of four hours or more, and how do they differ by time of day, weekday and admitting service?
items.population: Adult admission decisions in the emergency department, March 2025 to February 2027
items.intervention: Boarding-risk flag at the deployed threshold (index test)
items.comparator: Observed boarding of four hours or more from the admission decision to departure (reference standard)
items.time: At the admission decision, with boarding measured to departure
items.setting: Hospital emergency department and patient flow command centre

finer: Feasible from existing logs with one analyst day a week; interesting to the command centre and emergency clinicians; novel locally; ethical under the data governance approval; relevant because escalation effort depends on the flag.
summary: One accuracy question with pre-specified spectrum subgroups.
